---
title: "Relationships"
---

Explore how the novel's social world emerges as you read. View the entire
network, examine a curated literary group, or construct your own subset of
characters. The network distinguishes **observed textual co-occurrence** from
**machine-proposed semantic relationships**.

<div class="bk-network-controls bk-network-controls-v2">

<label>
<span>Network view</span>
<select id="bk-network-view">
<option value="all">All visible characters</option>
<option value="group">Curated group</option>
<option value="custom">Custom selection</option>
</select>
</label>

<label id="bk-network-group-wrap" style="display:none;">
<span>Character group</span>
<select id="bk-network-group">
<option value="karamazov-household">Karamazov household</option>
<option value="karamazov-brothers">Karamazov brothers</option>
<option value="central-relationships">Central relationships</option>
<option value="monastery">Monastery / spiritual circle</option>
<option value="khokhlakov">Khokhlakov household</option>
<option value="ilyusha">Ilyusha / schoolboy circle</option>
<option value="fyodor-social">Fyodor's social circle</option>
<option value="major-network">Major Karamazov network</option>
</select>
</label>

<label>
<span>Minimum shared passages</span>
<div class="bk-range-control">
<input id="bk-network-threshold"
       type="range"
       min="1"
       max="50"
       value="3">
<strong id="bk-network-threshold-value">3</strong>
</div>
</label>

<button id="bk-network-reset"
        class="bk-button"
        type="button">
Reset view
</button>

</div>

<div id="bk-custom-selection"
     class="bk-custom-selection"
     style="display:none;">

<div class="bk-custom-selection-header">
<div>
<div class="bk-eyebrow">CUSTOM NETWORK</div>
<strong>Select two or more characters</strong>
</div>

<div class="bk-custom-actions">
<button id="bk-custom-clear" class="bk-button" type="button">
Clear
</button>
<button id="bk-custom-all" class="bk-button" type="button">
Select visible
</button>
</div>
</div>

<div id="bk-character-checkboxes"
     class="bk-character-checkboxes"></div>

<label class="bk-neighbor-toggle">
<input id="bk-include-neighbors" type="checkbox">
<span>Include immediate neighbors of selected characters</span>
</label>

</div>

<div class="bk-network-layout">

<div class="bk-network-main">

<div class="bk-network-legend">
<span><i class="bk-legend-node"></i> Character</span>
<span><i class="bk-legend-edge"></i> Observed co-occurrence</span>
</div>

<div id="bk-network-status"
     class="bk-network-status"></div>

<div id="bk-relationship-network"></div>

</div>

<aside id="bk-relationship-detail"
       class="bk-relationship-detail">

<div class="bk-detail-placeholder">
<div class="bk-eyebrow">RELATIONSHIP INSPECTOR</div>
<h3>Select a connection</h3>
<p>
Click an edge to examine the textual observation, proposed interpretations,
and supporting evidence behind it. Click a node to inspect that character's
visible network.
</p>
</div>

</aside>

</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vis-network@9.1.9/dist/vis-network.min.js"></script>
<script src="assets/js/relationships.js"></script>
